preconditions.description: The length of A is greater than 0 and less than or equal to 10^6.
The length of B is greater than 0 and less than or equal to 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in A)
preconditions.description: All characters in A are either '0' or '1'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in B)
preconditions.description: All characters in B are either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string is greater than 0.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in output)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output string are either '0' or '1'.
The output string does not have any leading zeros.
The output string represents the binary sum of A and B.
